contract: Unformatted source Number ignores base in all six formats. Base is passed to an active formatter only.
Mini flags affect Unicode only; subscript takes precedence and whole source value is the map key.
Source initializer and value= setter are separate states. Each writer is called on a Marshal clone.
No formatter or caller-context propagation is added. Existing nonempty options refusals remain.
limitations: Ruby Float#to_s display remains explicitly unported.
Array/Hash inspection remains explicitly unported: common serialization loses Symbol/String element and key kinds.
Source refusal classes are compared; exception message bytes are not qualified.
